facts.fact: StackAdapt and Ascend2 released 'The State of Personalization in Digital Marketing' research report on February 11, 2026.
facts.quote: released _[The State of Personalization in Digital Marketing](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/downloads/personalization-trends-2026)_, a new research report developed in partnership with Ascend2.

facts.fact: The report is based on responses from more than 450 brand and agency marketers across North America.
facts.quote: Based on responses from more than 450 brand and agency marketers across North America

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report with Ascend2, 99% of agencies say personalization in digital marketing directly drives client revenue growth.
facts.quote: 99% of agencies say personalization in digital marketing directly drives client revenue growth.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report with Ascend2, 77% of agency marketers say quantifying and communicating results of personalized marketing campaigns remains a challenge.
facts.quote: 77% of agency marketers say quantifying and communicating results of personalized marketing campaigns remains a challenge.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report with Ascend2, 93% of brands and 94% of agencies agree that AI is improving personalization, but only one in five have fully integrated it across channels.
facts.quote: 93% of brands and 94% of agencies agree that AI is improving personalization, but only one in five have fully integrated it across channels.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report with Ascend2, 87% of brands plan to increase their spend on personalization in 2026.
facts.quote: Eighty-seven percent of brands plan to increase their spend on personalization in 2026

facts.fact: The survey gathered responses from 285 brand marketers and 183 agency marketers in the United States and Canada.
facts.quote: gathered responses from 285 brand marketers and 183 agency marketers in the United States and Canada.

facts.fact: Survey respondents represented organizations with more than $10M in annual recurring revenue.
facts.quote: Respondents represented organizations with more than $10M in annual recurring revenue

facts.fact: The survey was fielded in October 2025 and reported at a 95% confidence level.
facts.quote: The study was fielded in October 2025 and reported at a 95% confidence level.
